<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/buildings/{buildingId}/shifts/{shiftId}/staffing-gap"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



ADR-0011's deferred fast-follow: a fleet-wide "all paths, one building/shift" list endpoint, for contexts that need every path's staffing gap for a building+shift in one call rather than one request per path. Reuses the exact same per-path computation as GET /paths/\{pathId\}/staffing-gap — the two can never disagree for a given path — and raises PathUnderstaffed for every understaffed path in the plan. This surfaces the gaps only — it never decides or performs a rebalance; that stays a human call recorded via POST /associates/\{id\}/assignments.
